note: Mission-log rules. Wording is data: edit here without touching the engine. 'log' is the one-line entry, 'template' the detail shown on expand. Rules with shared=true are shown once for all scenarios with a per-scenario chip. Condition grammar: {metric, op, value|ref} | {all:[...]} | {any:[...]} | {flag}. Template fields {name|format}; formats: h, met, pct, pct0, wh, w, deg, x1, m, int.

rules.title: Terrain unavailable
rules.log: Treat every visibility figure here as an upper bound: terrain data is unavailable for this site.
rules.template: No terrain horizon is loaded for this site, so no sample can be classified visible. The figures shown assume no obstruction. Real terrain can only hide the Sun and Earth more often.

rules.title: Landing in darkness
rules.log: Land in darkness: the Sun stays hidden until {rise|met}.
rules.template: At T+0 the Sun is not classified visible above the terrain horizon. The first sunrise in the mission comes at {rise|met}.

rules.title: Battery floor
rules.log: Battery reaches its floor at {t|met} (est.): shed load or carry more storage.
rules.template: With a {load|w} load and a {bat|wh} battery ({dod|pct0} usable), the estimated charge reaches the depth-of-discharge floor at {t|met}. Engineering estimate on default or user-entered hardware values.

rules.title: No direct-to-Earth geometry
rules.log: No direct-to-Earth geometry in this window: Earth never clears {minEl|deg}. Plan on a relay.
rules.template: Earth is never classified visible above max(terrain horizon, {minEl|deg} minimum antenna elevation) during this mission. Geometric result only: this is not a link budget.

rules.title: Communications gap
rules.log: Buffer data and run autonomously for up to {gap|h} without Earth in view.
rules.template: The longest interval without Earth classified visible is {gap|h}, starting at {start|met}. That exceeds the stated limit.

rules.title: Storage
rules.log: Size storage for {gap|h} without Sun: about {wh|wh} usable at {load|w} (est.).
rules.template: The longest Sun obstruction is {gap|h}, starting at {start|met}. At {load|w} that needs about {wh|wh} of usable storage; {bat|wh} is installed. Rule-of-thumb estimate.

rules.title: Grazing geometry
rules.log: Treat grazing hours as unconfirmed: Sun {su|pct}, Earth {eu|pct} of the mission sit within {tol|deg2} of the limit.
rules.template: A sample is 'uncertain' when the body centre is within {tol|deg2} of the terrain horizon (or of the antenna elevation limit). Uncertain samples are not counted as visible. Sun: {su|pct} of samples. Earth: {eu|pct}.

rules.title: First sunset
rules.log: Fit critical first-day work before the first sunset at {t|met}.
rules.template: The Sun is visible at landing and first leaves the visible state at {t|met}.

rules.title: Panel orientation
rules.log: Mount the array vertically: about {x|x1} the energy of a flat one (est.).
rules.sharedLog: Mount the array vertically: it yields several times the energy of a flat one (est.).
rules.template: The Sun averages only {el|deg} above the horizon while visible, so a flat panel catches it at a grazing angle. A vertical Sun-tracking array yields about {x|x1} the energy of a horizontal one of the same area.

rules.title: Long shadows
rules.log: Expect long shadows: a 1 m rock casts about {len|m}.
rules.sharedLog: Expect long shadows: small terrain features matter more than usual for landing and imaging.
rules.template: With the Sun at {el|deg} on average while visible, a 1 m rock on flat ground casts a shadow about {len|m} long.
